changelog: **Shared meeting & misc routes on the permission layer (#1571, story #1565):** the caller-role comparisons in `/api/meetings`, `/api/meeting-series`, `/api/meeting-requests/[id]`, `/api/calendar-events`, `/api/availability`, `/api/evaluations`, `/api/documents`, `/api/document-reviews`, `/api/messages/[id]`, `/api/questions/[id]`, `/api/search`, `/api/tags`, `/api/support/attachments/[id]`, `/api/avatar`, `/api/users`, `/api/org/{usage,billing,plan-change}`, `/api/ai/{bulk-draft,artifacts/[id]}`, `/api/board/wip-limits`, `/api/contributor-terms`, `/api/events` and `/api/invite` now ask `requirePermission()` / `requireRoleOrPermission()` / `can()` instead of `role === 'ADMIN'` — an ADMIN is judged by tier (ORG_ADMIN keeps everything; an OBSERVER keeps reads), the other roles pass exactly as before. `/api/account`'s last-admin guard reads the deleted row's own role. The operator-AI audience marker in `/api/agendas/personalize` stays on the role (a billing class, listed as `allowed`). A signed-in caller of a role these routes never admitted gets 403 instead of 401.
